additionalProperties.value: Selects diagnostic, disk, updater or normal firmware from named firmware-directory images. Before normal OSOS, opens aupd; when its metadata state is zero, runs the power gate, writes state 1 through SetInfo, then loads it. This path mutates firmware metadata. Selector bytes 0x934..0xb5b match between 2.0.4 and 2.0.5; iTunes host sequencing remains unverified.
